parallel_live_run.elapsed_measurement: Upper bound from upload start to first observation of completion; not exact completion time.
parallel_live_run.anchor_scope: Selected phrases and continuity checks, not a character-accuracy score.
parallel_live_run.screenshot_state: 14/21 complete, two pages active, 134 seconds elapsed.

quality_settings.notes: Models, image resolution and verifier selection/budgets retained. Follow-up changes clarify literal reading and normalize recognized table representations.

core_regressions.training_fixture_note: The committed English PDF was checked in an isolated corpus because an unrelated local copy was truncated; the local copy was left untouched.

public_route_load.scope: Public routes and synthetic text; not image-model throughput.

initial_accuracy_issues: Question wording additions, omissions and one character substitution were found in visual source spot checks.
Separate missing-letter positions had an incorrect count.
Recognized HTML and pseudo-table markup appeared literally in the Word file.
Five unexplained trailing none labels remained.
All expected question illustrations were present, but one crop was tight and an extra crop contained a header fragment.
limits: No claim of error-free OCR or speedup factor: no serial benchmark was run on the same document.
Finished pages remain available while the same file stays open in the current tab; reload/close recovery is not guaranteed.
Temporary provider capacity and network latency can still affect completion time.
The source PDF, recognized text, exported Word and source-page images are not published in this repository.

changes: Conservative conversion of balanced recognized tables, pseudo-table rows, bounded table regions, nonbreaking spaces and outside-cell line breaks. No arbitrary HTML evaluation or tag stripping.
Preserve question clues before separate answer rules and exact counts of separate missing-letter positions.
Retain mathematical comparisons, legitimate none options, empty physical table cells and intentional multiline cells.
final_review: Compact wrappers normalize in one pass.
Supported flags without a colon remain allowed by the reader instructions.

targeted_live_run.remaining_observed_error: One character substitution remained in a question word.
targeted_live_run.scope: Focused question/text and Word-XML checks, not full character accuracy or full visual pagination review.

worker.retry: Same commit redeployed and backend revision matched. Gemini credential, generation and production image checks all passed.

remaining_limits: One observed OCR word substitution remains. Some answer-rule and crop layout details still require review.
